author: Roxey7
body:
Hi MapFern here,

(Formerly Roxey7)

I was sadly banned from Avicus by Taco334 (Pizza334) for hacking-killAura on January 27th.

I believe that I should be unbanned from avicus due to many reasons

>It has been a very long time 3 months since I was banned, I have changed and know have been playing on other servers much like avicus, but avicus has had the best supportive community and friends.

> Avicus had the best maps, and you were able to make your own maps and upload them ( I have made a couple of maps ) this opportunity has not been on many other servers and avicus had the best maps.

> This sorta is hard to believe, many mods have just said it was my fault, My friend actually got me banned he got killAura hacks and went on Avicus to get me banned as he knew it was my favourite server. ( I was not home at that time)

> I just love avicus playing so many maps, knowing with the Omega update came out, I would like to see this and play on the Omega update knowing how good it looks.

> The server was my favourite, played on it nearly every day for 1-4 hours a day sometimes even more. It was just once that my friend got hacks
 
Overall I would love to be unbanned, I have waited a hell of a long time and I know it was ages ago but it shows that my friend has changed.
Please could you unban me 

From MapFern

replies.body:
Hello MapFern!

I have decided to lift your punishment. However, if you are banned again, your chances of being unbanned will drop to a minimal. 

Regards,

Peacheh, Avicus Network Administrator.
